<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v1/account/{account}/server-signatures"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns signatures associated with the account. Currently only Gmail is supported, and only "new message" signatures from the "sendAs" list are returned.
